SELECT sor.id AS id, sor.id AS recordId, sor.batch_number AS recordNo, sor.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.specification AS specification, p.unit AS unit, sor.unit_price AS unitPrice, sor.quantity AS quantity, sor.total_price AS lineAmount, sor.out_type AS outType, sor.operator_id AS operatorId, COALESCE(op.real_name, op.username) AS operatorName, sor.remark AS remark, sor.create_time AS createTime FROM stock_out_record sor LEFT JOIN product p ON p.id = sor.product_id LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.id = sor.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_user op ON op.id = sor.operator_id ORDER BY sor.create_time DESC, sor.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
